headline: 🎯 Check Point VPN 9.8 RCE, 🧵 JFrog Artifactory admin-token chain, 🤖 Claude agent campaigns, 🛡️ Defender ShieldCrash fixed, 🛰️ UNC3569 Sogou backdoor, 🗂️ IDScan 153M licenses
summary: Check Point patched two CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated RCEs in its VPN gateways and Wiz detailed the full three-CVE Artifactory chain, while Anthropic and Google documented AI agent frameworks running intrusions at machine speed. A signed Sogou update channel dropping GRAYRABBIT, a 153-million-record IDScan breach, new KEV additions for MikroTik and N-central, and fresh IoT and RAT malware round out the day.

overrides.why: Two CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated RCEs in Remote Access and Site-to-Site VPN on Check Point gateways, dated today and never covered, so it leads over higher-scored recap slugs
Top advisory score, but its 09-11 events are French retranslations and an unrelated N-able recap, so there is no BlueMoon delta beyond yesterday's full write-up
New slug for the same Talos UAT-12197, UAT-11823 and UAT-11988 clusters already told in yesterday's Cisco FMC entry; the 09-11 events are outlet re-reports
High score but the write-up names no affected product for CVE-2026-21509/21513 beyond KEV status, so it cannot carry a grounded multi-sentence entry
Hunt.io ties a July council breach to CVE-2026-15409 mass SonicWall SMA1000 exploitation against roughly 250 targets and at least nine Active Directory domains, under-ranked at 4.5 on a single source
GRAYRABBIT delivered through the Sogou Input Method update channel is a signed supply-chain vector against a hundreds-of-millions-user install base, under-ranked at 3.5
Critical CSF/cPanel remote code execution and SQL injection in a widely deployed self-hosted hosting stack, carried by a routine advisory score
